lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: If you're selling something, I've got one of everything. If you're lost, the road's behind you.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: Neither. Your granddaughter sent me in.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: Neither. The door was open. Well. Unlatched.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Pippa sends in everyone. Last week it was a goat.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: ...Hm. An elf. There's a thing. Haven't seen one of you since I had both my knees.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Edda Brenn. This is my house, that's my kettle, and the chair you're eyeing is older than Pippa and twice as loud.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Retired from being a mage? Can you retire from being tall?

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: I stopped saving kingdoms. The magic kept happening on its own.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Like knitting, then. Never quite put it down.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: One. At the market in Brenn's Crossing, the summer the Hollow King fell.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: She bought nothing and asked my husband the proper names of weeds for an hour.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: ...That sounds uncomfortably like me.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Does it now.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: Pippa mentioned a garden.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: There's a meadow behind your house that looks like it used to be something else.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: ...Of course.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Jonas's garden. My husband. He had the whole back meadow in flowers once. Bluebells by the stones, daisies wherever they pleased, those pink things he could never spell.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Four winters gone now, Jonas. The garden managed two more springs without him and then it gave up. Sensible of it.

choices.text: I could bring it back. I know a spell for flowers.
Flowers wilt anyway. Does it matter?

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: A spell. For flowers.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: It's a very good spell. It's useless for almost everything else.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Ha! Now that I'd like to see.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Everything wilts, elf. That's never once stopped anyone planting.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: ...I could make some. I know a spell for it.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Then don't stand there being wise at me. Go on.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Everything he could get seed for. He kept a book. Names, dates, little drawings.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Terrible drawings. His daisies looked like fried eggs.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: I know a spell that grows flowers. They'd be the right ones. More or less.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: More or less is how Jonas did everything. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: The meadow's out back, round the corner of the house, past the woodpile.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: And don't make it tidy. He never did.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: The meadow's out back. You'll know it — it's the bit that looks disappointed.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Go on. I'll put the kettle on. The kettle and I have an understanding.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: He'd have hated it.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Hated that he didn't do it himself. Then he'd have been out here all night with his book, naming every one of them wrong.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: The blue ones are by the stones. You put the blue ones by the stones.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: The spell decides where they go. Mostly.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Mostly. Then your spell's got better taste than most people.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: He hummed when he weeded. Badly. He proposed to me with a radish, because roses were for people who hadn't thought about it.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Forty-six years and he never once remembered where he'd put his hat. I remembered for him.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: That's what it is, mostly. Remembering for each other.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: I'm bad at that part.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Then practise. You've got the time for it.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Small. You elves.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: You grew Jonas's garden back in one afternoon and you call it small. It's not the spell that's small, love. It's the afternoon.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Yes. And I'll have had a summer.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: ...That's a better answer than mine was.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: That summer at Brenn's Crossing. There was a young man at Jonas's stall. Sword on his back, hat like a fallen cake.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: He asked which flower lasts the longest. Jonas told him none of them do, that's the whole point of flowers.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: The boy laughed and bought a packet of everything. Said he had a friend who'd outlive the lot of us, and he wanted to know what she'd like.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: Teodor. He bought something from everyone. I don't think he ever planted any of it.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Hm. Maybe he wasn't buying them to plant.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: Then what for?

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Ask him.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: He lives on the coast now. I think. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: How long's 'a while', for you?

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: ...Fifty years.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Then it isn't a while. Go and ask him while he can still answer you.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Come back when they've gone to seed. Bring the girl a packet of something.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: In a few years, then.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: I'm seventy-nine, elf. Come back in a few weeks.

lines.speaker: char_linnaea
lines.text: ...Weeks. Right. I'll write it down.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: And shut the gate on your way. The goat's still about.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Still here? The flowers won't watch themselves. Actually, they will. Go on.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: The coast's east, if you've forgotten. Most things are east of here, eventually.

lines.speaker: char_edda
lines.text: Weeks, mind. I'm counting.
